2 اليَوْمَ تَسَرَّوْنَ , said by the Prophet on the occasion of the expedition of Ohod, means Today ye shall have your سَرِىّ [or that person, among you, who is distinguished by liberality and manliness, &c.,] slain: and [accordingly] Hamzeh was then slain. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, in six places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
